confirmedFindings.title: Missing ticker.Stop() causes runtime timer memory leak
confirmedFindings.body: Creating time.NewTicker without calling ticker.Stop() upon context cancellation leaks the timer in the runtime timer heap.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Add defer ticker.Stop() immediately after creating time.NewTicker.
